footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Federal Agricultural Mortgage: after $24.9M of preferred dividends. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. Operating income fell 0.9% to $256M, a 0.0% margin.
Net income rose 1.1% to $182M, or $16.62 per share. Operating cash flow was $80.1M and free cash flow $80.1M, versus $607M; Federal Agricultural Mortgage returned $12.9M through buybacks.
